text: DEFONEOS — DWP Universal Credit Automation Deep-Dive Pack EU AI Act Article 50 live 2 Aug 2026 — C2PA passport ready | Get yours → Home Master GovBench Article 50 DEFONEOS × DWP Universal Credit Automation Deep-Dive Pack Sovereign AI transformation of DWP Universal Credit — the UK's largest welfare programme serving 6.2M+ households. Audit-grade. Signed. UK-sovereign. 12 Entry Points 8 Transformation Priorities 6 MCP Servers 3 Backbone Orgs 🏛️ 12 Entry Points Core Operations UC Digital Service (UCDS) DWP's digital delivery arm managing the UC Full Service platform, journal, and claimant-facing services. 6.2M+ households. £72B+ annual payments. Case Management UC Service Centre Network 80+ service centres processing claims, changes of circumstance, and dispute resolution. 27,000+ work coaches managing UC claimant journeys. Fraud & Compliance UC Fraud & Error Division DWP's counter-fraud operation targeting the £8.3B annual UC fraud and error rate. AI-assisted overpayment detection and prevention. Payments UC Payment Engine Monthly payment calculation and distribution engine. HMRC RTI integration for real-time earnings. Third-party deduction management. Verification UC Verification & Identity GOV.UK One Login integration for claimant identity. DWP CIS (Customer Information System) verification. Third-party data matching. Health Assessments UC Health Assessment (WCA) Work Capability Assessment process for health-related UC components. ESA/PIP crossover management. AI-assisted decision support. Childcare UC Childcare Element Childcare cost verification and payment management. HMRC Tax-Free Childcare crossover. Provider registration and claims. Housing UC Housing Costs LHA (Local Housing Allowance) calculations. Direct payment to landlords. Housing cost verification and UC housing element management. Migration UC Migration & Legacy Transition Managed migration from legacy benefits (ESA, JSA, HB, WTC) to UC. Migration notice generation and deadline management. Oversight DWP Audit & Risk Assurance Internal audit of UC processes. NAO value-for-money reviews. PAC scrutiny and compliance evidence generation. Parliamentary Work & Pensions Select Committee Parliamentary oversight of UC operations. Select committee evidence and inquiry responses. Ministerial correspondence. Partner Data HMRC RTI / HMPO / Land Registry Real-Time Information earnings data. Identity verification. Housing ownership checks. Third-party data integration backbone. ⚡ 8 Transformation Priorities 1. Claim Lifecycle Evidence Chain End-to-end audit trail from initial claim through assessment, payment, review, and closure. Every decision point signed, timestamped, and immutably anchored. Covers 6.2M+ households. 2. Fraud Detection AI Governance Governed AI models for UC overpayment and fraud detection. Bias testing across protected characteristics. Explainable decision support. £8.3B annual fraud target. 3. Work Coach Decision Support AI-assisted work coach journal analysis. Claimant engagement pattern recognition. Sanction risk assessment with HITL override. 27,000+ work coaches. 4. Health Assessment AI Ethics Governed WCA decision support. Bias detection across disability categories. Explainable AI for benefit entitlement decisions. Appeals reduction through quality evidence. 5. Migration Automation Governance Managed migration notification automation. Legacy benefit transition compliance tracking. Deadline management with vulnerability safeguards. 2.6M+ remaining legacy claims. 6. Real-Time Earnings Integration HMRC RTI data matching automation. PAYE/SE earnings reconciliation. Overpayment prevention through real-time earnings monitoring. 95%+ matching accuracy target. 7. Housing Cost Verification Automated LHA compliance checking. Landlord verification and direct payment management. Tenancy fraud detection. Cross-referencing with Land Registry and council tax data. 8.
